data.text:
scale proof: Over 900,000 businesses move/spend £12B monthly, per wise.com.
problem mechanism: Multi-currency batch payouts to 1,000 contacts plus 22-currency accounting reconciliation, per Wise.
cost evidence: None found on fetched pages — uncertain.
counter-evidence: Advertises batch payments, accounting sync, 7M daily fraud checks, 24/7 support.
wedge fit: Uncertain — no evidenced costly gap identified for free fix.
verdict (worth 3-6k/month: yes or no): no
why: Scale is clear but no mechanism-plus-cost evidence supports paid urgency.
